text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Wherever the wind takes me, wherever my 
whim leads. To challenge the Satsuki Sho, 
I set foot upon the Triple Crown island.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The one to beat is Air Shakur! If we beat 
him, the results will follow—that's what 
the Navigator told me!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Shakur says the result is set in stone, 
but a race is always anyone's game on the 
day! You've gotta enjoy the thrill to the 
absolute fullest!
